data_description.sensor_rain_today: Precipitation accumulation or interval delta sensor.
data_description.rain_is_rate: Enable if rainfall rate integration is required instead of cumulative meter.
data_description.weather_entity: Weather forecast provider used to predict tomorrow's rain.
data_description.rain_tomorrow_cutoff: Precipitation cutoff above which automated irrigation is skipped.
data_description.reset_storage: Check to clear existing soil deficit and historical rain records from disk.
data_description.zone_1_switch: Switch entity controlling the Zone 1 latching solenoid.
data_description.zone_2_switch: Switch entity controlling the Zone 2 latching solenoid.
data_description.zone_1_area: Total irrigated garden bed area for Zone 1 in square meters.
data_description.zone_1_flow_rate: Total emitter discharge rate for Zone 1 in liters per hour.
data_description.zone_1_enabled: Allow automated morning irrigation dispatch for Zone 1.
data_description.zone_2_area: Total irrigated garden bed area for Zone 2 in square meters.
data_description.zone_2_flow_rate: Total emitter discharge rate for Zone 2 in liters per hour.
data_description.zone_2_enabled: Allow automated morning irrigation dispatch for Zone 2.
data_description.max_bucket: Cap on maximum allowed soil water deficit depth in millimeters.
data_description.safety_limit: Hard hardware safety limit for maximum single valve actuation duration.
